## Title of the story

A few words, the way you would say it aloud.

## Who told it

Name the person. If they are an IRMA or dairy alumnus, add the batch if you know it (for example, PRM 6, 1985–87). If you are the witness, say so.

## When and where

As much as you know. "I do not know the year" is a valid answer.

## The story

In your own words. A few paragraphs are enough. Do not paste a whole article, speech, or book chapter.

## Source link

The public page, clip, or bibliographic details. If the story has never been published, say that you are offering it as a witness.

## Anything you are unsure about

Names, dates, or details you would like an editor to check.
